title: Toys 'R' Us opens at Grand Central Terminal in NYC
text:
Toys 'R' Us opens at Grand Central Terminal in NYC - ABC7 New York 
 24/7 Live New York City New Jersey Long Island Northern Suburbs Connecticut SHOPPING 
 Toys 'R' Us opens at Grand Central Terminal just in time for holiday shopping 
 Friday, November 20, 2026 5:39PM 
 The iconic toy store opened in at Grand Central Terminal just as the holiday shopping rush begins. WABC MIDTOWN, Manhattan (WABC) -- Toys "R" Us is returning to Manhattan -- just in time for the holidays.
 The iconic toy store opened Friday in New York City's Grand Central Terminal, giving travelers a place to shop as they embark on holiday travels.
 After closing all of its stores back in 2018, Toys "R" Us has been mounting a comeback and has opened more than 160 locations nationwide and inside of other retailers, like Macy's.
 Beloved children's mascot Geoffrey the Giraffe officially opened the location with a ribbon cutting ceremony.
 Officials hope the store's new location will offer commuters, tourists and collectors of all ages a new place to shop and discover what's new and what's next.
